_provenance: Reference kit for the generated-driver format, hand-written on 2026-09-19 from
data/builds/dossiers/jax.json and the archived sources (Riot's 16.18 bin, the
wiki). Every number under `gen` is in the dossier or the numbers sheet; the
driver (engine/src/generated/jax.rs) reads them by dotted path and holds no
game number of its own. The windup is 30% + Riot's attack cast offset
name: Jax
notes: Grandmaster-at-Arms opens the fight: its swing lands after the 0.25 s cast, and for the 8 s it runs every second attack carries the on-hit instead of every third.

Empower is cast right after an attack lands, to use its attack reset: the empowered attack follows one windup later and the cooldown starts when it lands. A Leap Strike cast while Empower is armed takes the empowerment instead.
Leap Strike goes out on cooldown and its damage lands on the cast (the short dash is not modeled beyond the usual 0.25 s cast lockout).

Counter Strike is cast on cooldown and recast as soon as it can be (1 s); the dummy never attacks, so it always deals its minimum damage, and Jax keeps attacking during it. Its cooldown starts at the recast.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
